[[Sifu]]

You see a scaled creature in the center of the training room, on his knees silently meditating. His teal blue scales sparkle lightly, around his neck is a chain of large red spheres. He twitches his head slightly as you enter, and calmly says, "Do you know of the two dragons? Black and white, Khal and Shao, Yin and Yang. The spirits that make our souls."

To Melantha: "You have a wealth of Yang, but without Yin, Yang dies on the battlefield. You must achieve balance, and with balance there is strength."
"We must discover the source of your imbalance, are you conflicted, weak of mind or weak of body? Come, I shall show you the Enlightened Fist."

"You want to know of war? War is life, decisions are war within oneself, sometimes wars over so quickly, only because the choice is elementary to us. I will not give you advice of war, but advice of life, and this lesson is a story. Do you feel lost?"
"I was once lost in the forest, alone, and hungry, a long way from home, but I was saved by a little yellow bird."
"I caught it, and ate it."
"Oftentimes the correct answer is the simplest. If you must survive, then survive. Do not worry about the feelings of little birds, simply eat, and have the strength to walk."
